description: Changes one Notion data source (the table inside a database): its title, its property schema, or whether it is in the trash. The schema change is a map keyed by a property's current name: null removes the property for every row, {"name": "New"} renames it, and a type (alone or with name) changes its type and settings, in the forms notion_create_database takes. A select's options list replaces the whole list. Changing a type can leave existing values unreadable in the new type. Returns the data source's id, title, in_trash and property schema.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

data_source_id.description: The data source's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

in_trash.description: true moves the data source to the trash; false restores it.

properties.description: Property changes keyed by current name: null removes, {"name": "..."} renames, a type or {"type": ..., settings} changes the type.

title.description: The data source's title as plain text. Over 2,000 characters is split into several text pieces; the limit is 200,000.

name: notion-mcp__notion_update_data_source
